title: console: a drawer list view with navigation.preventNavigation still opens the record drawer on row click
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nWoa1Ze1QzjRTSYXD

Filing gate: ① an authored key the console ignores, with a named producer. It was found by the #33317 contract review on PR #33544 (record 6886428303, ③), read on the code, not driven live.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell` `ObjectView` row click). Grade p3, self-graded by the seat under the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」: an authored setting has no effect, and no data is wrong.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open preventNavigation` finds only #33317.

## 维护者速读

视图的 `navigation.preventNavigation` 在 spec 里的说明是「完全禁用标准导航」，但 Console 中 `drawer` 模式的列表在点击行时并不读取它，仍然写入 `?recordId=` 打开记录抽屉。

## Producer

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: `preventNavigation: z.boolean().default(false).describe('Disable standard navigation entirely')`.
- The console's `ObjectView` `handleRowClick` writes `?recordId=` for a `drawer` view without reading `navigation.preventNavigation`.
- After PR #33544, `rowOpensRecord` is keyed to the resolved mode, so such a row still looks openable. That is honest today, because it does open.

## Acceptance

- A view with `navigation.preventNavigation: true` opens no record on row click, whatever its mode. The host also folds it into `rowOpensRecord` (PR #33544), so the row stops looking clickable.
- Measure first whether any other host (`ObjectDataPage`, `InterfaceListPage`, the phone face) reads `preventNavigation`, and make them agree. Say in the PR which ones changed.
- Pins: `preventNavigation: true` on a drawer view opens nothing and draws no link face. CONTROL: `false`/absent opens the drawer as today.
- ⛔ No spec change. ⛔ Lands after PR #33544 (same files).
